name: Kanjivaram Zari Silk Saree
care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth and refold every three months.
description: A rich peacock-green Kanjivaram with a contrast zari border and a woven gold pallu.

name: Pochampally Ikat Silk Saree
care: Dry clean for the first wash. Later, gentle hand wash in cold water, dry in shade.
description: Geometric double-ikat weave in mustard with an indigo border, light enough for all-day wear.

name: Uppada Jamdani Silk Saree
care: Dry clean only. Keep away from direct sunlight and perfume.
description: Featherlight jamdani buttas on a blush-pink body. Woven to order in about three weeks.

name: Venkatagiri Handloom Cotton Saree
care: Hand wash separately in cold water with mild soap. Starch lightly for a crisp drape.
description: A soft, breathable everyday handloom with a contrast maroon zari-line border.

name: Mangalagiri Cotton Saree with Nizam Border
care: Machine wash gentle, cold. Wash dark colours separately for the first few washes.
description: Crisp Mangalagiri cotton with the classic Nizam border. Pairs with a contrast blouse.

name: Dharmavaram Pattu Saree
care: Dry clean only. Air the saree in shade between wears.
description: Broad gold-zari border and a heavy temple-motif pallu on a deep maroon body.

name: Banarasi Georgette Saree
care: Dry clean only. Fold with tissue between the zari layers.
description: Flowing georgette with a woven gold jaal. A good evening saree.

name: Chanderi Silk-Cotton Saree
care: Dry clean recommended. If washing, use cold water and a mild detergent, no wringing.
description: Sheer-textured Chanderi in lilac with tiny gold buttas along the pallu.

name: Chikankari Cotton Kurta Set
care: Hand wash in cold water. Do not bleach. Iron on reverse.
description: Three-piece set: kurta, pant and dupatta. Hand chikankari on the yoke and hem.

name: Raw Silk Bridal Lehenga Set
care: Dry clean only. Store hung, in a breathable garment bag.
description: Lehenga, blouse and dupatta set. Fitted to your measurements, ready in about four weeks.
